title: epan: Use unsigned for proto_set_appendix_len
description:
The field information start and length are already unsigned.
Make the appendix start and length unsigned as well. The
appendix length is already 0 when not used instead of -1,
and other code already checks if the appendix length is 0
and treats that as no appendix, so there's no need to use
signed integers and check for -1 or other negative lengths
or offsets.

Ping #20103

AI-Assisted: no
